sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose The Interaction Document Enrichment (IDE) tool ensures that crucial context from analyzed attachments is preserved, clean, and easily scannable within the primary conversation log.
Inputs Interaction Record (Primary Input): The definitive record of the customer interaction.
Attachment Summaries: The clean, plain-text narrative summary of the documents from the previous step (containing no raw JSON syntax or technical metadata). If you are provided a JSON Payload as input, you will need to transform this into a clean, plain-text narrative summary of the documents.
Contextual Data for Action Original Interaction Record: The existing object targetted for the update.
Action & Logic Data Extraction & Clean Up: Extract only the relevant content from the result string within the response payload (discarding raw JSON syntax, metadata fields like sys_id, logId, or technical brackets).
User-Friendly Formatting: Format the final output cleanly. Introduce clear line breaks between the global summary and individual document summaries to avoid walls of text.
Direct Integration: Seamlessly append or embed this beautifully formatted text into the designated work notes field within the Original Interaction Record.
Key Output Determined Updated Interaction Record: The enriched Interaction Record. It now cleanly displays the structured summaries with explicit line breaks for each document, serving as a highly readable, single source of truth for the upcoming Specialized Case Classification
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Interaction Document Enrichment
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.pre_message: Enriching interaction record with attachment summaries

tool.display_value: Update interaction record with attachment summaries
